Canonical Kimi replies, read by the module's tests and quota's Kimi reader tests.
`balance.json` is the example from the official balance reference (platform.kimi.com/docs/api/balance);
`arrears.json` follows its rule that a negative cash balance is arrears and available then equals the
voucher balance; `usages.json` is the Kimi Code `/coding/v1/usages` shape as kimi-cli reads it
(observed, not in the official reference).
